# vpsie_migration_source (Resource)

A Migrate source: the platform a migration reads servers from (for example VMware ESXi or vCenter, Nutanix AHV, an image file or an SSH-reachable host). The platform registers the source when it is created, which tests the connection; a source that cannot be reached is not created. SSH-based sources (`kvm-libvirt`, `any-server-rescue`, `xcp-ng`) also need their host key confirmed in the portal before a job can run.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vpsie_migration_source" "esxi" {
  type                  = "vmware-esxi"
  name                  = "lab-esxi"
  datacenter_identifier = "dc-identifier"

  settings = {
    host     = "10.0.0.5"
    username = "root"
  }

  credentials = {
    password = var.esxi_password
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `datacenter_identifier` (String) The datacenter whose nodes run the source's jobs. Changing it replaces the source.
- `name` (String) The source name. Changing it replaces the source.
- `type` (String) The source type, for example `vmware-esxi`, `vmware-vcenter`, `image-file`, `proxmox-ve`, `proxmox-pbs`, `xcp-ng`, `nutanix-ahv`, `kvm-libvirt`, `any-server-rescue` or `openstack`. The types available to the account are listed by `GET /migrate/source-types`. Changing it replaces the source.

### Optional

- `credentials` (Map of String, Sensitive) The connector's secret fields as strings (for example `password`). Stored sensitive in the state and never read back from the platform. Changing them rotates the credential in place after the platform has tested the new one; give every secret field of the type, as the platform expects.
- `settings` (Map of String) The connector's non-secret fields as strings (for example `host`, `port`, `username`). Which fields a type takes is defined by the platform per type. Changing a setting replaces the source.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the source was created (RFC 3339).
- `host` (String) The host the source connects to, as the platform records it.
- `identifier` (String) The source identifier.
- `status` (String) The source status.
- `username` (String) The user the source signs in as, as the platform records it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import vpsie_migration_source.esxi source-identifier
```

Credentials are not returned by the platform: after an import, set `credentials` in the configuration; the next apply rotates them.
